title: valerianella multidentata var. oscensis
intro: Valerianella multidentata var. oscensis, commonly known as Oscense Valerianella or Wild Corn Salad, is a perennial plant species in the valerian family that grows in the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. It is known for its edible leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being. The health benefits of Oscense Valerianella include its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a stomachic, expectorant, and diuretic, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
